DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。銀行からの通知について、何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there a problem with a notice from the bank?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通知が銀行へ戻ったと聞きました。郵便の転送を頼んでいるので、新しい家に届くと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 銀行に通知が戻ったと聞いたが郵便転送を申し込んでいるため新居に届くと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard the notice was returned to the bank. I arranged mail forwarding, so I thought it would reach my new home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you heard the notice was returned to the bank but expected it at your new home because you arranged forwarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当行の登録住所も変更されていますか。通知の種類によっては転送されないことがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you also changed your registered address with our bank? Some types of notices may not be forwarded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 郵便だけ手続きして、銀行には伝えていませんでした。登録には前の住所が残っているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 郵便の転送だけ手続きして銀行には住所変更を伝えておらず、登録に旧住所が残っている可能性があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only arranged the postal procedure and didn't tell the bank. My old address may still be registered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only arranged mail forwarding without notifying the bank of the address change, so the old address may remain registered. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の登録住所を確認して変更方法をご案内します。新住所を確認できる書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check your registered address and explain how to change it. Have you brought documents verifying the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この書類があります。妻も同じ銀行を使っているので、私の変更で妻の口座住所も変わると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所の書類を示し、妻も同じ銀行を使っているので自分の変更で妻の口座住所も変わると思っていたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have this document. My wife uses the same bank, so I thought changing mine would change the address on her account too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the new-address document and say you thought changing your address would update your wife's account too because she uses the same bank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 口座の登録住所は、それぞれのご本人について確認します。奥様の変更を一緒に申し出る場合も、必要な書類と受付条件を別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The registered account address is checked for each account holder individually. Even if requesting your wife's change together, please separately check the required documents and acceptance conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の分を先に確認します。妻には自分の手続きを確認してもらいます。戻った通知を再送できるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の住所変更を先に確認し妻には本人の手続きを確認してもらうと伝え、戻った通知を再送できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check my own change first. I'll ask my wife to check her own procedure. I'd also like to ask whether the returned notice can be sent again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will first check your address change and have your wife check her own procedure, and ask whether the returned notice can be resent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻った通知の確認と送付の扱いは担当へ照会します。住所変更が済む前に、再送先が確定したと考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll ask the person in charge about the returned notice and delivery arrangements. Don't assume the resend address is confirmed before the address change is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人の登録住所を変更し、手続き結果を確認します。妻の分とは分け、戻った通知の扱いも担当に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の登録住所を変更して結果を確かめ、妻の手続きとは分けて戻った通知の扱いを担当者に聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll change my own registered address and check the result. I'll keep it separate from my wife's procedure and ask staff what happens to the returned notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will change your registered address and check the result, keep your wife's procedure separate, and ask staff about the returned notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お持ちの書類で確認を進めます。通知についても担当へご案内します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll proceed with checking the documents you brought. We'll direct you to the appropriate staff about the notice too. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。どのような商品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What sort of product are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍋に入れる肉団子を探しています。この丸い商品なら、肉だけで作られていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍋用の肉団子を探しているので、丸い形の商品が肉だけで作られているか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking for meatballs for hot pot. Is this round product made only from meat?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are looking for hot-pot meatballs and ask whether a round product is made only from meat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 形だけでは原材料を判断できません。商品名と裏の表示を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can't judge the ingredients from the shape alone. Let's look at the product name and label on the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 魚肉の練り物と書いてあります。肉団子だと思っていました。今日は鶏肉を使ったものを希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示は魚肉の練り物だったが肉団子だと思っていたと説明し、今日は鶏肉を使った商品を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says processed fish paste. I thought they were meatballs. Today I'd like something made with chicken.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the label says fish paste though you thought it was meatballs, and request a chicken product today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 鶏肉の候補をご案内します。ほかに、原材料で確認したいものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll show you chicken options. Are there any other ingredients you'd like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 卵を使っているかも確認したいです。食事の条件を決めた家族に、表示を見てから選ぶと伝えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 卵が使われているかも確認したいと伝え、家族に原材料表示を見てから選ぶと話していると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd also like to check whether egg is used. I've told my family, who set the dietary requirements, that I'll choose after reading the label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you also want to check for egg and have told your family you will choose after reading the ingredient label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 候補ごとの原材料と注意書きをご確認ください。わからない点はメーカーの案内でも照会できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check each option's ingredients and warnings. You can also inquire through the manufacturer's information about anything unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 冷蔵の表示も見ました。先に別の買い物をするので、今かごへ入れず、最後にこの売場へ戻って買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 冷蔵表示を確認したが先に別の買い物をするので、今はかごに入れず最後に売場へ戻って購入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I checked the refrigeration label too. I have other shopping to do first, so I won't put it in my basket now; I'd like to return to this section and buy it last.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you checked the refrigeration label but have other shopping first, so you will not put it in the basket now and will return to buy it last. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保存方法を守れる順番でお選びください。選んだ商品の表示を、会計前にも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please choose an order that lets you follow the storage instructions. Check your chosen product's label again before checkout too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 形で肉と決めず、鶏肉と卵の表示を確かめます。冷蔵品は最後に買い、家に着いたら表示どおり保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 形で原材料を決めつけず鶏肉と卵の表示を確かめ、冷蔵品は最後に買って帰宅後も表示どおりに保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume it's meat from the shape. I'll check the chicken and egg information. I'll buy refrigerated products last and store them as labeled once home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not infer ingredients from shape, will check chicken and egg labels, buy refrigerated products last, and follow storage instructions at home too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要な条件に合う表示か確認してお選びください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check that the label meets your requirements before choosing. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で、何かご不明なことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is anything unclear about using the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子供と遊びたいです。この遊具が空いているので、私も一緒に乗ってよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供と遊びたいので、空いている遊具に大人の自分も一緒に乗ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to play with my child. This play equipment is empty; may I, as an adult, ride it with them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to play with your child and ask whether you may ride the unused play equipment with them as an adult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 遊具の対象や使い方は、掲示で確認してください。お子さんの年齢は表示の範囲に入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the sign for who the equipment is intended for and how to use it. Is your child's age within the range shown?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 子供は六歳で、表示の対象年齢に入っていますが、大人は対象ではなさそうです。誰も使っていなければよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子供は対象年齢に入っているが大人は対象ではなさそうだと伝え、誰も使っていなければ利用できると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My child is six and within the displayed age range, but adults don't seem to be included. I thought it would be okay if no one else was using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your child is within the age range but adults seem excluded, and explain that you thought being unused meant you could use it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この遊具の表示は三歳から六歳が対象で、大人は乗る対象ではありません。外側の黄色い見守り位置から付き添えます。空いていても、大人が一緒に乗れるという案内ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The sign on this equipment is for ages three to six; adults aren't intended to ride it. You can supervise from the yellow position outside. The instructions don't allow adults to ride together even when it's empty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 中へ入って隣に立つつもりでした。子供を見守れる外側の場所を確認して、そこから声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遊具の中で子供の隣に立つつもりだったが、外側で見守れる位置を確認して声をかけると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was going to go inside and stand beside my child. I'll check the outside place where I can supervise and speak to them from there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you had intended to stand beside your child inside the equipment, but will check an outside supervising position and speak from there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 黄色い見守り位置で、遊具が動く範囲や通路を空けてください。お子さんが休む時は、遊具を降りたことを確認して一緒にベンチへ移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: At the yellow supervising position, keep the equipment's movement area and the path clear. When your child rests, make sure they've got off the equipment and move to the bench together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子供が休みたいと言ったら、先に遊具を降りてから一緒にベンチへ行きます。席を取るために子供だけ残しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子供が休みたがったら遊具を降りて一緒にベンチへ行き、席を取るために子供だけ残さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If my child says they want a break, we'll get off the equipment first and go to the bench together. I won't leave them alone to reserve a seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the equipment and go to a bench together when your child wants a break, without leaving them alone to reserve a seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにしてください。遊具の不具合や気になる点があれば、管理先へ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do that. If you notice a defect or anything concerning about the equipment, let the management know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 対象年齢と付き添い位置を守ります。遊具を離れる時は子供と一緒に、休憩場所へ移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象年齢と付き添い位置を守り、休憩のため遊具を離れる時も子供と一緒に移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll follow the age range and supervising position. When leaving the equipment for a break, I'll go to the rest area with my child.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will follow the age and supervising-position rules and move together with your child when leaving the equipment for a break. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。周りの利用者にも気をつけてお楽しみください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Enjoy yourselves while being mindful of other visitors too. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。列車のご利用で、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your train journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子供をベビーカーに乗せています。持ってきた案内に「混雑時は折り畳んでください」とありますが、今の便でどう準備するか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参した案内に混雑時はベビーカーを畳むとあるので、今の便への乗車準備を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child is in a stroller. The instructions I brought say to fold it when crowded, and I'd like advice on preparing for this service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your instructions say to fold the stroller when crowded, and you want advice on preparing to board this service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内の条件と、利用する便の状況を確認しましょう。畳む場合、お子さんを抱いて待てる同行者はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check those conditions and the situation on your service. If folding it, is there someone with you who can hold your child while waiting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夫が一緒なので、子供は夫が抱けます。ただ、下のかごに荷物を入れたままです。乗り口で急に畳むのではなく、先に荷物を分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夫が子供を抱けるがかごに荷物があるので、乗り口で急に畳まず先に荷物を分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My husband is with me and can hold our child. But there are still bags in the basket underneath. I'd like to separate the bags first rather than suddenly fold it at the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your husband can hold the child but the basket contains bags, so you want to separate them first rather than fold suddenly at boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お子さんと荷物を分け、通行を妨げない待機場所で準備しましょう。荷物と畳んだベビーカーは、どなたが持つ予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's separate your child and the bags and prepare in a waiting place that keeps the passage clear. Who plans to carry the bags and folded stroller?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私が持ちます。夫には子供だけをお願いしたいです。今の便に間に合わなくても、準備が整うまで乗り込まないことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分が荷物と畳んだ車体を持ち夫は子供を担当し、便に間に合わなくても準備前には乗り込まないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. I'd like my husband to handle just our child. Even if we miss this service, we won't board until we're ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will carry the bags and folded stroller while your husband handles the child, and you will not board before being ready even if you miss this service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その役割分担で、お二人とも準備できてから乗車を相談してください。便を変える場合は、お持ちの切符の条件も別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: With that division of tasks, please ask about boarding once both of you are ready. If changing services, we'll separately check your ticket conditions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。混雑の確認と、畳んだ後に置く場所を係員に聞きたいです。通路やドアの前に置けるとは考えず、乗る前に説明を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 混雑状況と畳んだ車体の置き場所を係員に尋ね、ドアや通路に置けると決めず乗車前に説明を受けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'd like to ask staff about crowding and where to put the folded stroller. I won't assume it can go in a passage or in front of a door; I'd like an explanation before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask staff about crowding and storage for the folded stroller, and say you want an explanation before boarding rather than assume doors or passages are suitable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今の便の状況と車内の置き場所を確認します。確認の間はここで一緒にお待ちください。案内を聞いてから、乗る便をお決めになれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We'll check this service's situation and where to store it on board. Please wait here together while we check. You can decide which service to take after hearing the guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 夫は子供、私は荷物とベビーカーを担当します。待機場所で準備し、混雑と置き場所を確かめてから乗ります。便を変えるなら切符も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 夫は子供、自分は荷物とベビーカーを担当し、待機場所で準備して混雑と置き場所を確かめ、便変更時には切符の条件も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: My husband will handle our child, and I'll handle the bags and stroller. We'll prepare in the waiting area and board after checking crowding and storage. If changing services, we'll check the ticket too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say your husband will handle the child and you the bags and stroller, prepare in the waiting area, check crowding and storage, and check ticket conditions if changing services. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備の場所と乗車案内を確認しますので、お二人でお待ちください。ご相談ありがとうございます。お気をつけてご旅行ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait together while we check the preparation area and boarding instructions. Thank you for asking. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなお手続きについてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What procedure would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子供が生まれたので、必要な手続きと持ってくる物をまとめて知りたいです。父親の私が相談しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供が生まれたので父親として相談しており、必要な手続きと持参物をまとめて知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: We've had a baby, and I'd like an overview of the necessary procedures and what to bring. I'm asking as the father.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your baby was born and you are asking as the father for an overview of necessary procedures and items to bring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: おめでとうございます。出生に関する届出と、給付などの相談は担当が異なる場合があります。病院からの書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Congratulations. Birth registration and consultations about benefits may be handled by different staff. Do you have the documents from the hospital?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。届出とお金の申請が一つだと思っていたので、それぞれの窓口と期限を一覧にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 病院の書類は持っているが出生の届出と給付申請を一つだと思っていたので、それぞれの窓口と期限を一覧にしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought registration and applying for money were one procedure, so I'd like a list of the counter and deadline for each.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have hospital documents but thought birth registration and benefit applications were one procedure, and want a list of the respective counters and deadlines. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ちの書類で担当を確認します。ご本人とお子さんの情報や、世帯の状況も窓口で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll use your documents to check the appropriate staff. The counter will also ask about you, your child, and your household circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母親はまだ入院中です。私が全部代わりにできると決めず、本人の署名や委任が必要な手続きがあるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母親は入院中なので自分がすべて代理できるとは決めず、本人の署名や委任が必要な手続きがあるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The mother is still hospitalized. I don't want to assume I can do everything for her; I'd like to ask whether any procedure needs her own signature or authorization.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the mother is hospitalized, so you will not assume you can handle everything as a representative, and ask which procedures require her signature or authorization. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 代理でできる範囲と必要書類は、手続きごとに確認してください。今日は相談内容を整理してご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check what can be done by a representative and the required documents for each procedure. Today we can organize your questions and give directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 病院の書類、私の本人確認書類、家族から預かった書類を分けて持っています。預かっただけで代理権があるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 病院の書類、自分の本人確認書類、家族から預かった書類を分けており、預かっただけで代理権があるとは考えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've brought hospital documents, my identification, and documents entrusted to me by my family separately. I don't assume just holding the documents gives me authority to act for them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have separated hospital documents, your own identification, and entrusted family documents, and do not assume possession alone gives authority to represent someone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように、どなたの書類かを担当に伝えてください。確認した期限と、不足している物をメモしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the staff whose documents each belongs to, in that way. Let's note the confirmed deadlines and missing items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 届出と給付を分け、窓口、期限、代理の条件、不足書類を書きます。母親に必要な確認も伝えてから手続きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出生の届出と給付申請を分けて窓口、期限、代理の条件、不足書類をメモし、母親にも必要な確認を伝えてから手続きすると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll distinguish registration and benefits and note the counters, deadlines, representative conditions, and missing documents. I'll also tell the mother what needs checking before proceeding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate birth registration and benefit applications, note counters, deadlines, representative conditions, and missing documents, and tell the mother what needs checking before proceeding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当窓口へご案内します。ご家族の状況に合わせて確認してください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to the relevant counters. Please check according to your family's situation. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。予約について、何をご相談されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about your appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 次の受診日に移動できないかもしれません。天候が心配なので、予約を後ろへずらせるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 天候が心配で次の受診日に移動できないかもしれないので、予約を後の日に変更できるか相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I may not be able to travel on my next appointment date. I'm worried about the weather and want to ask whether I can move it later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say weather concerns may prevent travel on your next visit date, and you want to discuss moving the appointment to a later day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約日時と診療科を確認します。延期すると、今お持ちの薬は次の受診まで足りる見込みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the appointment date, time, and department. If postponed, do you expect your current medicine to last until the next visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 数えたら予定の日まではありますが、延ばした日までは足りません。予約だけ変えればよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残薬は元の受診日までは足りるが延期した日までは足りず、予約だけ変えればよいと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I counted it, and there's enough until the original day, but not until the postponed one. I thought changing just the appointment would be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your remaining medicine lasts until the original appointment but not the postponed date, and you thought only the appointment needed changing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 残っている薬の数と、受診が難しい事情を医療担当へ伝えます。こちらで薬の量や飲み方は変更できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell medical staff the amount of medicine remaining and why attending is difficult. We can't change the quantity or how you take it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 薬を半分にして持たせるのはやめます。今の指示どおり使いながら、どう相談すればいいか担当へつないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬を半分に減らして持たせることはせず現在の指示どおり使うので、相談方法を聞くため医療担当につないでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't halve it to make it last. I'll keep following the current instructions, so please put me in touch with medical staff to ask how to discuss this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not halve the medicine to make it last but follow current instructions, and ask to speak to medical staff about how to obtain advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。移動の見込みと予約変更の希望も合わせて伝えます。連絡を受けられる番号は変わっていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. I'll also pass on your travel situation and appointment-change request. Is your contact number unchanged?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号は同じですが、勤務中は出られません。折り返す時の窓口を聞き、会社にも連絡を取れる時間を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話番号は同じだが勤務中は出られないので、折り返し先を聞き会社にも連絡できる時間を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The number is the same, but I can't answer while working. I'll ask where to call back and discuss with my company when I can make contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your number is unchanged but you cannot answer at work, so you will ask for the callback contact and discuss an available time with your company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 折り返しの連絡先をご案内します。担当からの確認前に予約変更が済んだとは考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll give you the callback contact. Don't assume the appointment change is complete before the staff have checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 移動の不安、残薬が足りないこと、連絡できる時間を伝えます。薬は自分で減らさず、担当の説明を聞いてから受診日を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 移動の不安と残薬不足、連絡可能な時間を伝え、服薬を自分で減らさず医療担当の説明を聞いてから受診日を決めると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the travel concern, insufficient remaining medicine, and when I can be contacted. I won't reduce the medicine myself; I'll decide the visit date after hearing medical staff's advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will report travel concerns, insufficient medicine, and contact availability, not reduce medication yourself, and decide the visit date after medical staff explain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。担当へおつなぎします。今後の案内をご確認ください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Noted. I'll put you in touch with the appropriate staff. Please check the next instructions. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駐輪していた自転車が見つかりません。雪かきの後から場所がわからなくなったので、盗難の相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 除雪後に駐輪していた自転車が見つからないので、盗難について相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't find my parked bicycle. I lost track of its location after snow clearing, so I'd like advice about possible theft.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot find your bicycle after snow clearing and want to discuss theft. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に確認した日と、停めた場所を教えてください。雪かきで動かされた可能性は確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me when you last saw it and where you parked. Have you checked whether it may have been moved for snow clearing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日は建物の端にありました。管理の人にはまだ聞いていません。今日見えなくなったので、すぐ盗難だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日は建物の端にあったが管理者にはまだ移動の有無を聞いておらず、今日見えなくなったためすぐ盗難だと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was at the edge of the building yesterday. I haven't asked the manager yet. Because I couldn't see it today, I immediately thought it was stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it was at the building's edge yesterday, you have not asked management about moving it, and immediately assumed theft because it was not visible today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず確認できた事実を整理しましょう。安全に見られる場所だけ確認して、除雪された雪の山には入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's first organize the confirmed facts. Check only places you can safely see, and don't enter piles of cleared snow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 管理の人へ移動したか聞きます。雪の中へ探しに入らず、昨日撮った写真で駐輪位置を示したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 管理者に移動したか尋ね、雪の中に探しに入らず昨日の写真で駐輪位置を示したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask management whether they moved it. Rather than go into the snow to search, I'd like to show where it was parked in yesterday's photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask management about moving it and show yesterday's photo of the parking location rather than search inside the snow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真を拝見します。車体の特徴と、防犯登録の情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let me look at the photo. Do you have the bicycle's features and anti-theft registration details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 赤い自転車で前かごが白です。写真ではかごがカバーで隠れています。登録の控えに車体番号もあるので、一緒に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車体は赤く前かごは白いが写真ではかごがカバーに隠れていると説明し、車体番号のある登録控えも見せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's red with a white front basket. The basket is hidden by a cover in the photo. My registration slip has the frame number too, so I'll show it together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the red bicycle and white front basket hidden by a cover in the photo, and say you will also show the registration slip with its frame number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真と登録の情報で整理できます。移動の確認結果も、届け出の相談時に担当へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can organize the information using the photo and registration. Please also tell the person handling the report the result of checking whether it was moved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨日の位置と車体情報を示します。管理側へ移動の有無を確認し、不明ならその状態のまま担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昨日の駐輪位置と車体情報を示し、管理者に移動の有無を聞いても不明なら不明のまま担当者に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show yesterday's location and bicycle details. I'll ask management whether it was moved, and if it's still unknown, explain that unresolved status to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show yesterday's parking place and bicycle details, ask management about moving it, and report it as unknown if it remains unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。無理に雪の中を探さず、確認できた情報でご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Don't force yourself to search in the snow; consult us with the information you can confirm. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。書類の発送で、何をご確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about sending documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 契約書を送ります。追跡があれば、相手が受け取って署名したことまで証明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約書を送るため、追跡情報で相手の受領と署名まで証明できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sending a contract. If it has tracking, can that prove the other person received and signed it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are sending a contract and ask whether tracking proves the recipient received and signed it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追跡の情報と、相手の署名した契約書は別です。どの段階の記録が必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tracking information and a contract signed by the recipient are separate. Which stage do you need a record of?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 届いたかを知りたいのと、署名した原本を返してほしいのと、両方です。追跡だけで全部終わると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配達の確認と署名済み原本の返送の両方が必要で、追跡だけで済むと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both knowing it arrived and having the signed original returned. I thought tracking alone would take care of everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you need both delivery confirmation and return of the signed original, but thought tracking alone was enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送方法の記録で何を確認できるかご案内します。原本の返送は、相手と別に手順を決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll explain what each shipping record can verify. Please arrange the original's return procedure separately with the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相手に返送の説明を同封します。送る前に写しも残します。受け取った記録が必要な場合の方法も比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返送の説明を同封して写しも残し、受領の記録を残す発送方法を比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll enclose return instructions and keep a copy before sending. I'd also like to compare methods if I need a record of receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will enclose return instructions, keep a copy, and compare sending methods that leave a receipt record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追跡や配達記録の扱いを、方法ごとに確認しましょう。どの記録が必要かは、提出先の条件も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check tracking and delivery records for each method. Also check the submission recipient's requirements to establish which record you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社には、配達の記録と署名済み原本を別のものとして確認します。費用を見てから方法を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社に配達記録と署名済み原本を別々に確認し、料金を見てから発送方法を選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check delivery records and signed originals as separate things with my company. I'd like to see the fees before choosing a method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check delivery records and signed originals separately with your company and choose a sending method after seeing the fees. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。利用できる方法の条件と料金を確認してご案内します。契約の成立について、郵便の記録だけで判断はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We'll check the conditions and fees of available methods and explain. Postal records alone can't determine whether a contract has been concluded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 配達記録と署名返送を分け、会社の条件に合う発送方法を選びます。控えと追跡情報も保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 配達記録と署名返送を区別して会社の条件に合う方法を選び、控えと追跡情報を保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll distinguish delivery records from return of the signed document and choose a method meeting the company's requirements. I'll keep the receipt and tracking information too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish delivery records and signed-document return, choose a method meeting company conditions, and keep the receipt and tracking information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類と宛先を確認してから発送しましょう。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's check the documents and destination before sending. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。口座のお申込みについて、何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your account application?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 稚内で季節の仕事を始めました。寮に住んでいますが、短い勤務期間でも口座を申し込めるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 季節の仕事で寮に住み始めたので、勤務期間が短くても口座を申し込めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've started seasonal work in Wakkanai and live in company housing. I'd like to know whether I can apply for an account even with a short employment period.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have moved into company housing for seasonal work, and ask whether you can apply for an account with a short employment period. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務と居住の状況を確認して、当行の申込条件をご案内します。勤務先と今の住所がわかる書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check your work and residence situation and explain our application conditions. Do you have documents showing your employer and current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 雇用の書類と、寮の部屋が書かれた案内があります。会社の本社住所ではなく、今住む寮の住所を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 雇用書類と寮の部屋がわかる案内を持っており、本社ではなく現在住む寮の住所を伝えると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have employment documents and housing information showing my room. I'll give the housing address where I live now rather than the company's head-office address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you have employment documents and information showing your housing room, and will give your current housing address rather than the head office's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。勤務の期間と在留の期間も、それぞれ確認が必要です。書類のどの日付を見ていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. We also need to check your employment period and residence-permission period separately. Which document dates are you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 仕事は春までですが、在留カードの日付はそれとは別です。仕事が終わる日を在留期限として答えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕事の終了は春だが在留カードの期限とは別なので、雇用終了日を在留期限として答えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My job lasts until spring, but the date on my residence card is separate. I won't give the job end date as my residence-permission expiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your job ends in spring but your residence card's expiry is separate, and you will not give the employment end date as the residence expiry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの書類を示して、担当に状況をご説明ください。給与の受け取り先について、勤務先の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show each document and explain your situation to the staff. Does your employer specify where your salary must be paid?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 指定があるかまだ聞いていません。申込み前に会社へ確認し、寮を出た後の住所変更方法も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 給与口座に勤務先の指定があるか申込み前に確認し、退寮後の住所変更方法も知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't asked whether there is a requirement yet. I'll check with the company before applying, and I'd also like to know how to change my address after leaving the housing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the employer's salary-account requirements before applying and also want to know how to change your address after leaving company housing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 勤務先の条件を確かめてからご相談ください。申込みの可否と必要書類、住所変更の方法は担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consult us after checking your employer's requirements. The staff will explain whether an application is possible, the documents needed, and address-change methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 勤務期間、在留期間、今の寮の住所を分けて示します。会社の指定を確かめ、必要書類を揃えて申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勤務期間、在留期間、現在の寮住所を分けて示し、勤務先の指定を確認して必要書類をそろえて申し込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the employment period, residence-permission period, and current housing address separately. I'll check the company's requirements and gather the documents before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show work and residence-permission periods and your current housing address separately, check the employer's requirements, and gather documents before applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。状況に合う案内を担当が確認します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The staff will check the guidance appropriate to your circumstances. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。値札について、何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Is there a problem with the price tag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この缶詰は特売の金額で一個買えますか。二個持つと、もっと安くなるんでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 特売表示の缶詰を一個その金額で買えるか、二個ならさらに安くなるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Can I buy one of these cans at the special-offer price? Would taking two make them even cheaper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether one can can be bought for the special-offer amount and whether two would be cheaper still. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の対象数量を確認しましょう。この金額は二個セットについての表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the quantity covered by the display. This price is for a set of two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一個の価格だと思っていました。二個なら一個当たりはいくらか、単品の値札と比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一個の価格だと思っていたので、二個セットの一個当たりの価格を単品価格と比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was the price for one. I'd like to compare the per-can price for two with the single-item price tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you thought it was a single-item price and want to compare the per-can price in the two-pack with the single-item price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 単品の表示もこちらです。セットの条件と合わせて見てください。今日は何個必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The single-item price is here too. Please look at it together with the set conditions. How many do you need today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 必要なのは一個です。安く見えたので二個買いそうでしたが、家にも在庫があるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要なのは一個で安く見えて二個買いそうだったが、家の在庫を先に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I need one. It looked cheap, so I nearly bought two, but I'd like to check whether I already have some at home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you need one and nearly bought two because it looked cheap, but want to check your home stock first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家庭の在庫も考えて必要な量をお選びください。種類が違う物を組み合わせられるかは、対象の表示を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please consider what you have at home and choose the amount you need. Check the display to see whether different varieties can be combined.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族に聞いたら、同じ缶詰が二個あるそうです。今日は買わず、必要な別の商品だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族に聞くと同じ缶詰が二個あったので、今日は買わず必要な別の商品だけ選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I asked my family, and they say we already have two of the same cans. I won't buy any today; I'll just get the other product I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your family confirmed two identical cans at home, so you will not buy them today and will choose only another necessary product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。かごに入れた物を戻す時は、同じ商品の場所か職員へお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. When returning items from your basket, place them in the same product's location or hand them to staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: セット価格と単品価格を分けて確認できました。この缶詰は職員に渡し、買う予定だった別の商品を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: セットと単品の価格を区別できたと伝え、缶詰を職員に渡して予定していた別の商品を探すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've been able to distinguish the set price and single-item price. I'll hand this can to staff and look for the other product I planned to buy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have distinguished the set and individual prices, will hand the can to staff, and look for your other planned item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらでお預かりします。在庫と必要な量を確認してお選びいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, I'll take it here. Thank you for checking your stock and the quantity you need before choosing.
